_comment: Validation config for one database (it_validation.<db>.config_path in backend/dq_config.json). Copy per database and keep only the source section it reads: 'oracle', 'mariadb' or 'sqlserver'. The real files hold passwords - keep them out of git.
_comment_mariadb: HAQ. jdbc_url optional (else the pipeline's own URL); ssl optional (else read from the URL).
_comment_sqlserver: LIFT. Windows login: give the domain (or keep domain=NA in jdbc_url) and the user without it. jdbc_url optional - blank uses the pipeline's own URL (CDC pipelines keep theirs in a resource file, so set it or capture it on the page). host / port / database / instance override parts of the URL. driver: pymssql (pip install pymssql) or jdbc (needs Java, pip install jaydebeapi JPype1, and driver_jar = path to the mssql-jdbc .jar). trusted: true signs in as the account the portal runs under (Windows) instead of user/password. encrypt: true forces TLS (needs pymssql 2.3+).
_comment_snowflake: Read login for the Snowflake side. role can be a list - each is tried until one can read the table.
_comment_snowflake_save: Where results are written for the IT Checks page (scheduled run, and 'Write to Snowflake' in Pipeline Studio).
